hardCaps.publicInvariant: Historical Assessments, RuleHits, decisions and Audit entries are immutable.
One ReviewCase has at most one fenced terminal decision.
One Remediation Run and Assessment pair has at most one append-only correction.
Tenant risk, review and audit state never crosses tenant boundaries.
Request replay and external event identity each create at most one atomic effect.
Every Assessment freezes the active RuleVersion at its acceptance boundary.
Expired Work owners cannot commit and every durable Work reaches one terminal effect.
Compatible migration preserves all V1 identities, responses, Work, Events and audit history.

specGaps.summary: An unresolved Review Assessment has no published oldDecision value for AssessmentCorrection.
AssessmentCorrection reason content generation is not published.
Remediation snapshot keys and sort tuples are not published.
The recovery barrier wire protocol and internal commit checkpoints are not published.
